title: The future of physical format in video games sparks debate: Sony faces protests and Rockstar weighs in
summary: Sony's moves towards a completely digital ecosystem prompt a boycott petition, strict guidelines, and reflections from executives like Dan Houser on the permanence of discs.

title: Capcom announces its plan to release a Resident Evil game each year through remakes
summary: The Japanese company confirmed its strategy to keep the franchise with annual titles, mainly remakes, which will allow other projects like Pragmata.

title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls faces criticism for PC performance issues and its developer apologizes
summary: The open beta of the fighting game presented serious technical problems, leading Arc System Works to issue official apologies.

title: Cyan Worlds shows a preview of a new Myst sequel that will never be released
summary: The studio reveals a teaser of a canceled Myst saga project, confirming that the game will not reach the market.

title: Final Fantasy 14 will come to Switch 2 and revamp its housing system
summary: The popular MMORPG announces its launch on Nintendo's console and two major updates for the housing system, while Yoshi-P comments on Chort.

title: Rockstar details the regional lock of GTA 6 pre-order codes and speculation about multiplayer
summary: The developer clarifies the geographical restrictions for digital pre-orders, while analysis emerges about the future of Grand Theft Auto 6's multiplayer mode.

title: The cooperative zombie game Yet Another Zombie Defense HD is free on Steam for a limited time
summary: The zombie defense title can be obtained at no cost on Steam, allowing permanent ownership if claimed before the end of the offer.
